tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bka' brgyud gser phreng bzhugs/

bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i bstan pa'i chos mtha' dag bsdus na rten gyi gang zag skad cig mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byed pa'i lam gyi brjod tshul ma nor ba rtogs pa'i rim pa cig ston pa legs te/ de la chos ci snyed cig gsungs kyang bsdus na/ theg pa thun mong ba'i lam dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gnyis te/ de yang theg pa thun mong ba drang ba'i don du bstan pa ni/ blo'i rig pa tha dad pa'i dbye bas rig gsum theg pa thun mong ba drang ba'i don du bstan pa ni/ blo'i rig pa tha dad pa'i dbye bas/ rig gsum theg pa rnam pa gsum du bshad de/ de yang theg pa'i go ba yang*/ 'og ma'i sa nas gong ma'i sar 'degs par byed pa'i don gyis na theg pa zhes bya ste/ de yang nyan thos kyi theg pa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa/ theg pa chen po/ de ltar yang mdo las/ sems can drang ba'i don gyi phyir// theg pa gsum du bstan pa yin// ces pa dang*/ gtso bor dkon mchog gsum 'dzin pa// theg pa mchog gsum ston pa po// ces pa'i tshul gyis/ theg pa tha dad par bstan pas so// de las theg pa thun mong ma yin pa/ theg pa chen po las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad/ nges pa'i don du gcig kho nar nges te/ de ltar yang 'phags pa rtog pa chen po las/ sangs rgyas theg chen gcig tu las// gnyis dang gsum zhes dbye ba med// ces pa dang*/ yang gzhan las/ yang dag du na snang med pas// theg pa gcig tu yang dag gnas// ces gsungs pa'i tshul gyis bstan ste/ theg pa thun mong ba drang ba'i don mi ston ste/ theg pa thun mong ma yin pa/ theg pa chen po yi chos kho na ston par byed ste/ theg pa chen po la gnyis te/ rgyu lam du byed pa/ mtshan nyid pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/

'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa lam gcig char du 'jug pa gnyis ste/ de yang rgyu mtshan nyid pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa ni/ lam rim gyis pa don spyi'i tshul du yid la byas nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas de thob bya'i yul dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas thob par byed pa ni ring ba'i lam mo// de las 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni/ lam gcig char ba don rang gi mtshan nyid mngon gsum du nyams su myong nas/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum dbyer med rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid do// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med par/ 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i don skad cig la thob ste/ nye ba'i lam du bstan te/ de ltar gnyis las dang po ma yin te/ gnyis pa ston/ 'di las yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi ste/ bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud las/ 'dir ni gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do// de yang thabs gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud dang*/ shes rab gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud/ gnyis su med pa phyed pa'i rgyud gsum las/ 'dir bla na med pa rgyud sde du ma zhig gi nang nas byin rlabs gtso bor ston pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud lags/ 'di byin rlabs che ba'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dngos su bzhugs ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dngos su bzhugs pas na byin rlabs che zhing bka' gnyan pa'o// de'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa'i don mdor bsdus nas/ gsang ba sbas pa snyan rgyud 'di lags ste/ 'di la gsum/ brgyud pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ snod dang ldan pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ don dang ldan pa gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub sems kyi rgyun ma chad cing sdom gsum dang ldan pa snyan rgyud nyams kyi rgyud pa ma chad cing gnyug ma'i drod tshad shes pas/

byin rlabs bka'i rgyud pa ma chad cing rtogs pa mchog dang ldan pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ snod gsum gyi skyon dang bral bas ste/ de yang thos pa'i dus su snod kha sbubs lta bu'i skyon dang bral ba/ bsam pa'i dus su snod zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon dang bral ba/ tha ma bsgom pa'i shes rab kyi dus su snod dug can lta bu yi skyon med pa'o// gsum pa ni dbang dang 'brel ba rgyud kyi gdams pa/ byin rlabs dang 'brel ba snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa/ brda' dang 'brel ba ngo sprod kyi gdams pa'o// de la bar pa byin rlabs dang 'brel ba snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa ni/ sgro 'dogs gcod byed gsum ste/ phyi bla ma sprul pa'i sku'i 'khor lo la brten nas/ brgyud pa'i sgro 'dogs gcad pa dang*/ nang nyams len longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i gdams ngag la brten nas lam gyi sgro 'dogs gcad pa dang*/ gsang ba ngo sprod chos sku'i gdams ngag la brten nas/ gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa'o// nang nyams len longs sku'i gdams ngag la gnyis/ smin lam dang*/ grol lam mo// ༈ //rin chen bai ḍūr+ya bzhin 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod re skong zhing*// thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug nyi zla ltar gsal bdag nyid can// gsal 'grib dang bral nam mkha' lta bu kun khyab snying rje ni// ma bzhin brtse ba bde stong dbyer med zhabs la 'dud// gnyis dag lnga ldan chos sku gzugs sku gnyis// sgrib med sgrib spang rang byung ye shes ste// gsang ba gsum ldan 'khor lo rnams gsum gyi// rgyu 'bras dbyer med gnas lugs rim pa bri// de la thog mar bla ma rin po che rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma chad pa/ dpal rdo rje 'chang nas sgron me gcig nas gcig tu mched pa lta bu'o// nyams kyi gdams ngag ma rig pa'i mun pa sel bar byed pa/ brda' don bkrol bar mdzad pa'i/ (ma dpe ldeb bzhi pa ma tshang*/)

lha gang zhes kyang bya/ u rgyan gha dho la'i gtsug lag khang zhes kyang bya/ thams cad dug mtsho 'bos dang*/ lcags kyi ri dang*/ srog chags gdug pa can mang pos bskor ba/ sgo rim pa gsum dang*/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang bcas pa na/ sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa yod pa'o// de'i dbus dharma gha dzā chos kyi mdzod bzhugs pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma rnam pa gsum bzhugs pa las/ phyi sprul sku za byed las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni/ 'bangs sgo ma'i tshul du bzhugs nas snod min thams cad tshar gcod pa'i bya ba byed do// nang longs sku 'jig rten las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni/ rgyud kyi bdag mo mdzad cing mchod pa la brtson par bzhugs so// gsang ba chos sku dri med ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus na bzhugs pa med pa'i tshul gyis/ gnyis su med pa bde ba chen po'i ngo bor bzhugs so// de yang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnam gsum gyi ngo bor ni bzhugs so// de yang rang byung gi sku'i gsang mdzod dang*/ yig 'bru gsung gi gsang mdzod dang*/ phyag mtshan thugs kyi gsang mdzod gsum du bzhugs te/ de la mi phyed pa'i lcags gsum bcug /rgya rim pa bdun dang bcas pas bzhugs pa'o// de yang bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs te/ rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun de dag kyang re re la yang*/ 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bye bas yongs su bskor te/ rdo rje dha ki dang*/ las dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rin chen rigs/ sangs rgyas rigs/ dam tshigs dang*/ sna tshogs dang*/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa bzhugs so// lhan cig skyes ma gsang ba'i yum ni/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum gyi tshul du/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje gri gug dang*/ thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba g.yon na 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/

yon tan gyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir rgyan dang cha lugs dang ldan pa'o// de la dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor bas ste/ shar gtum drag dang*/ rgyal po en tra bo de dang*/ byang tshang tshing 'khrig par/ ku ku ri pa dang*/ nub u rgyan du/ pad+ma badz+ra dang*/ lho 'jigs su rung bar/ klu grub snying po dang*/ 'tshams su ni/ shar lhor dpal gyi gnas su/ lho bho bhi he ru ka dang*/ lho nub bdun pa mi bzad par/ rdo rje dril bu pa dang*/ nub byang ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs par/ klu yi ba dang*/ byang shar ha ha rgod par/ dpal sa ra ha chen po dang bcas pa'o// de dag kyang zhing skyong shing brgyad la gnas pa dang*/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ klu'i rgyal po dang*/ phra men ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa/ ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ 'jig rten ba dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i gnas mchog tu gyur pa yin no// ༈ //sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa te lo pa la/ rnam par thar pa bsam kyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi langs pa yin yang*/ mdor bsdus pa'i yon tan la bzhi las/ dang po mi rang brgyud par bstan pa la yang bcur yod pa las/ sku 'khrungs pa nas mkha' 'gro ma zil gyi mnan cing chos gsan pa'i sngon ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs las za hor gyi bye brag las/ grong khyer dz+nya kor zhes bya ba 'dod pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i rig pa'i gnas du ma'i 'byung gnas du ma der/ yab bram ze gsal ba zhes bya ba rigs khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ yum bram ze ma gsal ldan zhes bya ba gnyis la/ sras mo bram ze mo gsal sgron zhes bya ba gcig 'khrungs/ 'phyis sras kyis dben nas gnas pa la/ bram ze dang drang srong dang 'jig rten pa'i lha thams cad kyang mchod/ khyad par du dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa rgya chen po phul zhing gsol ba btab pas/ dpal bde mchog dang*/ rje btsun ma la yang gsol ba btab pas/

zla ba dgu'i ngo bo bcu na sras gcig btsas pa'i tshe/ rgya gar shar phyogs de 'od kyis khyab par gyur pas/ de'i tshe/ bram ze mtshan mkhan spyan drangs nas/ mtshan ltas brtag pa'i tshe/ res 'ga' lha/ res 'ga' klu/ res 'ga' mi dang*/ res 'ga' sangs rgyas nyid kyi mtshan ltas 'dra ba byung bas/ der gang yin ma shes te/ rang bzhin khyad par 'phags par shes pas/ 'di ni lha klu gnod sbyin dang*// sangs rgyas gang yin ma 'tshal te// skyes bu ngo mtshar can gyi mchog /'di ni shin tu legs par skyong*// zhes zer te/ mtshan yang bram ze gsal 'od du btags so// zas dkar gsum dang mngar gsum la sogs pa brten nas/ shin tu gces par bskyangs pa la/ shin tu skyed che bar byung ste/ lo gcig lon pa'i dus su/ yum gyis dang kar la nyi grib mtshams su bzhag pa'i tshe/ snyan pa'i tshigs gis bsrong zhing yod tsam na/ bu'i steng du sngar mthong ma myong ba'i grib ma 'jigs pa cig byung bas/ rgyab ngos su bltas tsa na/ bud med rgan mo mi sdug pa'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa cig byung bas/ yum shin tu skrags te/ khyod 'dir ma 'dug par song byas pas/ de na re/ gces par brkyangs kyang mi 'chi ba'i sa phyogs de yang yod ma yin/ zhes zer zhing song ba la dris pa/ thabs ci ltar byas na mi 'chi byas pa la/ gzhon nu mdzes pa'i mtshan dang ldan/ dam chos brda skad phrad na bde zer/ de brda dang sgra rnams bslabs pas/ thogs pa med par shes te/ shin tu skyed che bar byung ste/ lo yang bcu drug tsam lon pa'i tshe/ rigs byed la yang byang zhing*/ legs pa'i yon tan du ma mnga' ba cig byung ste/ gnas pa la/ yang sngar gyi mkha' 'gro ma nag mo 'jigs su rung ba de byung nas/ yi ge 'bri zhing ma he skyongs// ltos med sa la'i nag gseb tu// khye'u bram ze gsal 'od thong*// mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan 'byung*// zhes zer ba la/ yab yum gyi zhal nas/

de snga phan cad kyang lung bstan ci zer bden/ da yang lung bstan gyi rjes su 'brang dgos zer nas/ de nas nang par ma he rnams yab dang gnyis kyi ded nas yab log nas khang par song*/ sras kyis ma he rnams gzan la brgyabs nas/ shing sa la'i sdong po gcig la sku rgyab gtad nas yi ge bri zhing bsdad pas/ yang bud med mi sdug pa'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa de byung nas/ yul la sogs pa gang yin zhib tu drir byung ba la/ yul ni grong khyer za hor yin// pha ni bram ze gsal ba yin// ma ni bram ze gsal ldan ma// sring mo bram ze gsal sgron yin// nga rang bram ze gsal 'od yin// shing ni sa la'i sdang po yin// ma he nor phyir skyong zhing 'tsho// yi ge bri nas dam chos byed// byas pa la/ bud med de khros nas/ yul la sogs pa thams cad de ltar med zer/ yang yi ge bltas pas sangs mi rgya/ sangs rgyas na/ dmus long gi rang byung gi ye shes chen po'i de bzhin nyid kyi sangs rgyas gar song ces zer cing 'dug pas/ sras kyang cung zad skrag te/ ci ltar yin dris pas/ e ma de ltar ga la yin// yab ni bde mchog 'khor lo la// yum ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sring mo nga ni lha mo bde ster ma// yul ni nub phyogs u rgyan yin// ming po pan tsa pa na yin// byang chub shing gi nags tshal du// nyams myongs ma he skyongs 'dod na// snyan rgyud yi ge med pa'i don// phyi nang gsang gsum ldan pa yi// dri med mkha' 'gro ma la yod// gsung nas/ lung bstan pa la/ lung bstan dam tshig ldan pa yi/ grub thob khyed kyis blangs na lon gsungs/ der mkha' 'gror shes te 'gro ba la/ lam shin tu bgrod par dka' bas/ ngas 'gro ba'i thabs ma mchis zhus pas/ rin po che shel gyi skas dang*/ rin po che'i zam pa dang*/ lde mig gcig dang gsum bskur te/ ngas byin gyi rlabs pas tshegs ma mchis zer te/

skas dang zam pas rgya 'bos 'joms// lde mig 'bras bus lcags sgrogs khrol gsungs ste/ da tsham tshom med par song gsungs nas/ pha ma la zhus pas/ ma shin tu mi dga' ba la/ yab kyis kho rang ci gsung bzhin byas pas chog ste 'ong gsungs ste/ de ltar gyis cig gsungs nas/ rdzas rten 'brel gsum po khyer nas nub phyogs u rgyan du 'gro ba'i lam thams cad la thogs pa med par chod nas/ ghan dho la chen po'i lcags ri'i drung du slebs ste/ dug mtsho'i 'bos la zam pa byas/ lcags ri la skas btsugs nas/ gtsug lag khang gi sgo'i drung du 'gro ba la/ lcags phyes nas phyin pa dang*/ tshar gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma tshan gnyis/ rjes su 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gcig yod pa las/ phyi sprul sku za byed las kyi mkha' 'gro ma na re/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs ni sna tshogs ni ston/ mi snyan pa'i sgra nga ro sna tshogs sgrogs zhing*/ nga ni za byed mkha' 'gro ma/ sha la dga' zhing khrag la rngam/ ces zer ba dang*/ der lus kyi 'jigs pa'i lta stangs/ ngag rngam pa'i lta stangs/ sems kyi mi skrag pa'i lta stangs gsum byas ste/ slar la phar byon te/ cher 'jigs mkha' 'gro du mas kyang*/ nga'i ba spu'i rtse mi g.yo/ de thod brgyal te/ brgyal sangs pa dang gzod bzod gsol byas pa de/ mar me la sbrang ma bzhin// bdag 'joms bsgoms pa ga la 'ong*// bdag ni 'bangs ltar dbang chung bas// bar blon ma la ma dris na// bdag ni sha za khrag 'thung bas// dam pa bdag la gnyer dgongs mdzod// ces zer nas/ nang du drir song bas/ longs sku 'jig rten las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sngar bzhin du byung ba la/ sngar ltar lta stangs gsum mdzad de/ sngar bzhin du byung ste/ bzod par gsol nas nang du drir song bas/ rje btsun ma ye shes mkha' 'gro ma ras dmar po dri ma med pas gdong bkabs ste/ skal pa bzang po can nang du thong cig gsungs nas btangs ba'i dus na/

tai lo pas phyag ma byas pas/ rang gi rtog pa gcig gi ngo bo zhugs pas/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa rnams stan las langs nas/ 'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi// yum 'gyur bcom ldan 'das ma la// mi gus tshul can cis mi 'joms// ces gsungs ste/ der rje btsun ma nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi// yab 'gyur bcom ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// dpal ldan sdom pa'i bdag nyid de// 'di ni mkha' la rdo rje'i ser ba drag 'bebs kyang*// sdom par mi nus chos byin ces gsungs nas// chos gang dang gang 'dod gsungs pa de thams cad ma blangs pas/ der rje btsun ma'i zhal nas/ khyod su yin/ lung ston mkhan sus byas/ don ci yod nas 'ongs/ don gang la dgongs dris tai lo pas/ nga rang pan tsa pa na yin// sring mo bde ster ma yis btangs// don ni yang dag don la dgongs// thun mong mchog gi khyad par gyi// gsang chen dri med bde chen zhu'o// zhes zhus pas/ der sku gsung thugs kyi brda' gsang mdzod rnam pa gsum la/ sku rang byung dpal ldan lhan cig skyes pa'i yab yum gyi sku dang gcig /gsung chos 'byung gru gsum gcig na/ yi ge bdun pa rin po che bai ḍūr+ya'i rang byung dang*/ thugs kyi rang byung rin po che rtse lnga gsum la gzigs pa mthong ste/ chos kyi gsang mdzod de rgyud gsum du gzigs te zhus pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang mdzod nas// yid bzhin nor bu rnam gsum po/ lta bsgom spyod pa 'bras bu dang*// dam tshig rang grol gdams ngag zhu// ces zhus pa ste/ nga la gsang mdzod zhu na ni// yid bzhin nor bu rnam gsum yod// ma rig mun sel lhan cig skyes// brda' 'di ni shes na khyod la sbyin// ces gsungs ste/ rang byung sku'i skor mdzod nas// dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu zhu// yig 'bru gsung gi dkor mdzod nas// thun mong yid bzhin nor bu zhu// phyag mtshan thugs kyi dkor mdzod nas// gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu zhu// zhes brjod pas/

mkha' 'gro ma rnams na re/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang mdzod nas// yid bzhin nor bu rnams gsum la// dam tshig lung bstan grub thob pas// rgyas btabs phyir na skal ldan yang*// khyod kyis dpal kyi sgo mi phyed// ces lan mdor bstan nas/ rgyas par byed pa ni/ rang byung sku'i dkor mdzod na// thun mong yid bzhin nor bu la// lung bstan ldan pas lcags bcugs nas// ma bstan pa yis phyed mi 'gyur// yig 'bru gsung gi dkor mdzod nas// dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu la// dam tshig ldan pas lcags bcugs pas// mi ldan pa yis byed mi 'gyur// phyag mtshan thugs kyi dkor mdzod nas// gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu la// grub pa thob pas lcags bcugs pas/ ma thob pa yi byed mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa la/ tai lo pas/ de gsum yod par lan btabs pas// lung bstan dam tshig ldan pa yi// grub thob khyod kyi blangs na lon// sa la'i tshal ni nags 'dab na// mkha' 'gros lung bstan lde mig yod// ces gsungs pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ha bgad dang bcas pas thal mo brdeb te/ khyed la lung ston med bdud kyis bslus pa yin zhes pa ni/ dmus long bltas pas gzugs mi mthong*// 'on pas nyan bcugs sgra mi thos// lkugs pas smras pas don mi go /zha bos brgyugs pas rjes mi slebs// bdud kyis bslus pas bden pa med// ces gsungs pas/ tai lo pas lan btabs pa/ rdzun ni nyes pa'i tshig yin te// nyes pa zad pa rdzun gyi tshig /smras par mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir// nam yang gsung pa med pa na// bdud min mkha' 'gro ma ru bden// zhes gsungs ste/ bdud mkha' 'gro ma ma yin pas/ gdams ngag zhu zhes zhus te/ lde mig yod pa'i don gsungs pa/ gsang ba'i mdzod gsum rgyas btabs la/ gnad kyi lde mig rnam gsum gyis// rim pa gsum du phye ba ni// dra ba sdom pa'i rgyud don yin// mkha' 'gro gsang tshig thugs kyi sdom// ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron// rang rig rang byung rang gsal ba'i// dam tshig rang byung lde mig yod/

gang yang skye ba med pa yi/ dam tshig rang byung lde mig yod// gang yang skye ba med pa yi// sems nyid chos nyid chos sku gsum// lung bstan phyag rgya chen po yi// lhun grub nyams kyi lde mig yod// dmigs pa yid la mi byed cing*// dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa yi// dran pa rdul tsam med gyur pa// mi gnas bde ba chen po yi// grub thob nyams kyi lde mig yod// ces gsungs pas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams mos te/ gsang ba sin dhu ra rdo rje ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par ngo sprad pas/ dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mas/ bdag gi yab 'gyur bcom ldan 'das// bde mchog 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /tai lo sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// yid bzhin nor bu rnams gsum 'bul// ces gsungs nas/ snyan rgyud byin rlabs dang bcas pa ma lus par gnang ngo*// spyir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos rgyud tha dag kyang gnang*/ gdams pa'ang gnang*/ yang snying gsang ba'i don rnams gdams pa ste/ rgya mtsho'i rgyud drug dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyar kyi rgyud dang*/ he ru ka bzang po'i rgyud dang*/ he ru ka snying rje rol pa dang*/ dpal rdo rje rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyud/ bde mchog rdo rje 'phreng ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje 'chang rang byung gi rgyud la sogs pa mang du gnang ste/ rgyud du ma gdan drangs par bzhed do// der mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub kyis nam mkha' la gshegs pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la ni bya bzhin du// thogs med shes rab bzang po 'gro// snang ba dbyings kyi stong gsal du// rig pa'i ye shes nga 'phur ces gsungs pas/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis bshol btabs pa/ skyes bu khyed ni gang du 'gro// bdag cag rjes su bzung du gsol// ces gsungs pas ma gnang te/ na ro ri ri ka so ri// bu rnams rtogs te rnal 'byor bdag

/gtsug gi nor bu'i dgon par 'gro// gsungs nas byon pa dang*/ bar snang mtshams su lus med ye shes mkha' 'gro mas/ sku lus mi mngon par/ sgra'i sgo nas chos skor dgu gsungs pa ni/ chos skor dgu gnang te/ spyod pa chu la ral gri rgyob// dam tshig rang sems me long ltos// dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'des/ smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud shigs// rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo bskor// rig pa ye shes sgron me ltos// ro snyoms phyi yi me long ltos// rang grol phyag rgya chen po ltos// bde chen gsung gi rin chen chongs// zhes chos skor dgu gsungs pas/ der gdams ngag rnams thugs su chud de/ sgyu ma lus kyi gha dho lir/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i gsang bcugs ste/ brjod med ngag gi lcags bcugs nas// 'od gsal mkha' la gnyis med 'gro// gsungs nas/ gtsug gi nor bu'i dgon par byon no// de rnams ni mkha' 'gro ma rnams zil gyi mnan cing chos gsan pa'i yon tan no// ༈ //gnyis pa mi'i bla ma med par bstan pa'i yon tan ni/ der rje tai lo pas u rgyan du ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la chos gsan nas grub pa thob zhes grags pas/ rgya gar shar nub thams cad du snyan pas khyab pas/ mi rnams kyis thams cad sgro 'dogs chod par 'dod pa'i khyed bla ma gang dang mjal zhus pas/ nga la mi'i bla ma med nga'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen/ ces pa dang*/ bden gnyis don la mngon gyur tai lo pa// rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas pa ste// khyod la mi yi bla ma yongs med de/ de'i bla ma gang yin thams cad mkhyen// ces mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis nam mkha' gsungs pa'o// der gzhan ma dad pa bsal ba'i phyir/ mi'i bla ma yod par bstan pa ni/ phyogs bzhi bla ma bzhi dag la// bka' bab bzhi bab pa ni// slob dpon tsar+ya pa las/ rgyud bde mchog la brten nas/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum pa'i chos kyi gtum mo'i bka' babs/

slob dpon klu grub snying pos rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa la brten nas/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i dgongs pa ston pa sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug gi chos dang*/ slob dpon la ba pas snyan rgyud dgyes pa rdo rje la brten nas/ gnyid 'od gsal lam du 'jug pa dang*/ rtog pa lam rten med rang grol gyi chos dang*/ pad+ma badz+ra nas mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo la/ rgyud sdom pa rgya mtsho la brten nas/ bde ba lam 'pho ba bar do'i bka' bab so// tsar+ya klu sgrub la ba pa// skal ba bzang mo nga'i ni// bka' babs bzhi'i bla ma yin// in tra bo de la sogs yin// ces gsungs so// yang gzhan sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ 'pho ba/ bar do/ grong 'jug gtum mo// phyag rgya chen po rnams la yang zer ro// ༈ //gsum pa rnal 'byor nus ldan zil gyi mnan pa'i yon tan ni/ yul phyogs de na rgyal po chen po gcig ma la gus shing ma'i mngag mi gcog pa gcig yod pa des/ ma la rigs pa'i rtsa ba ci 'dra ba gcig bya zhes dris pas/ rgyal khams rang gi skor na/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams dang ku su li rnams thams cad bsogs nas/ tshogs 'khor byas na bsod nams kyi mthar thug yin no gsungs pas/ des ma'i ched du de ltar byed do zhes thams cad su bsgrags ste dus btab bo// de rnams byon nas/ so so rang rang gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ rnal 'byor ba nus pa dang ldan pa gang che ba gcig gis dpon byed pa yin pa la/ gzhan gyi mi nus pa che ba gcig la zhus nas/ khri la bzhugs pa dang*/ rgan mo mi sdug pa'i gzugs can gcig nang du thong zer cing khro ba gcig byung nas/ sgo phye ba dang*/ tshogs dpon de la khyod kyis mi 'ong zer/ da ltar nga las drag pa su yod/ sus 'ong zer bas/ nga'i ming pos 'ong zer/ gang na bzhugs dris pas/ dur khrod chen po 'bar ba 'dzin bya ba na/ gzhon nu rol pa'i rtsed mo mdzad cing bzhugs/ de na re 'ong na khrid la shog dang*/

nga rang nus pa 'gran la gang che ba gcig gis bya yis zer ba dang*/ spyan drangs pa dang*/ mi sngo bsangs ras kyi ā gha rag gsol ba spyan rtsa dmar tsa le ba gcig byung ste/ der khri la mnyam par bzhugs nas nus pa 'gran pas/ mnyams des dkyil 'khor lha dang bcas pa gcig bzhengs nas/ der tai lo pas kyang bzhengs so// der nus ldan gyis ma shigs so// snga ma ni tai lo pas bshigs so// yang des ro gsar rnying mang po bkugs nas/ tshogs dang mchod pa'i rdzas su yid du 'ong ba mang por bsgyur ba dang*/ de tshe tai lo pas dmigs pa gtad pas dur khrod du bskyal lo// tai lo pas kyang dur khrod kyi ro mchod rdzas su bsgyur ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pas ma shigs so// des tai lo pas lus pags pa phyi nang bzlogs nas/ ba spu'i bu ga re re nas gsang sngags kyi lha gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa re re dang*/ 'dzam bu gling du ma nas sangs rgyas mang po bzhugs pas/ sems can bsnyen pa dang grol bar mdzad pa dpag tu med pa sprul pa dang*/ de nas seng ge la zhon nas nyi zla sa la babs nas/ de'i steng du phar rgyug tshur brgyugs byas pa dang*/ des gang yang ma nus par slar dad de/ e ma 'di ni ngo mtshar spyod// ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul 'di lta bu// rgyu ni ci las byung ba yin// 'di 'dra rnal 'byor gang nas byon/ gsungs pas/ der tshogs dpon mdzad de/ der rnal 'byor pa nus ldan kyis phyag byas/ bskor ba byas maṇ+ḍal phul nas gdam ngag zhus so// ༈ //bzhi pa mu stegs pa btul ba'i yon tan ni/ yul phyogs de na mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas shing nus pa che ba gcig gis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nag 'byam du btangs pas/ de gdul byar gzigs nas/ kho chos 'chad pa'i mdun na/ phar phyin pas/ khyod nga la rtsod pa bdo ba gcig 'dug zer/ khyod dang nga rang nus pa dang rtsod pa gang la yang 'gran gyis zer nas/ rgyal po dpang por bzhag nas dus btabs te/

gang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug par chad byas pas/ der khri gsum la rgyal po dang rnam gsum bzhugs te/ dang po sgra tshad lung rigs la rtsod pa byas kyang lan gsum bar du rgyal/ de nas nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'gran te/ gnyis ka dkyil 'khor lha dang bcas pa bzhengs zhing bshig pa la sogs pa thams cad mnyam pa la/ nyi ma brtod la mnan pas rdzu 'phrul rnams 'das par byas tai lo pas bzungs pas des phrul bar ma nus pas/ tai los nga'i bstan pa la zhugs skra'i la ba pa can byas pas/ de khros nas kha nas me phyungs nas me sbar nas/ tai lo 'jigs su ma nyan te/ mu stegs pa na re/ khams sum kun rnams g.yo byed pa'i// nga mi 'jigs pa'i rnal 'byor su// ces pa dang*/ tai lo pas me de bas che gcig phyungs pas/ sngar gyi me dang gnyis ka bzlogs nas btangs pas/ skra'i la ba tshun chad bsregs nas/ nga ni 'jigs pa kun las ni// yongs su grol phyir tai lo yin// gsungs pas/ mu stegs pa de dad de 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal bskor ba byas nas gdams ngag zhus te/ der thams cad grol te nag po dge ba bsil ba'i tshal de'i gdams ngag ni zhal las shes par bya'o// ༈ //bslu byed sgyu ma mkhan btul ba'i yon tan ni/ rgyal po chen po yod pa la/ sgyu ma mkhan ra tsa gcig dang 'gras pas/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i dmag drangs nas/ pho brang la nye ba'i yul thams cad pham par byas pas/ rgyal pos sgyu mar ma shes nas// mi rnams bred nas ci ltar bya gros byed pa'i sar/ bud med mi sdug pa'i mtshan can mkhar ba la brten pa gcig byung nas/ khyed rnams ci byed ces so// rgyal pos gzhan gyi yul khams 'phrog pas gros byed ces so// mo na re ngas gros byed dgos pa yin/ ra tsa'i spyan sngar 'phrin gyis gcig zer nas/ 'bangs kyis phyi'i blon la dri/ des nang gi blon po la/ des rim gy-is rgyal po la bsnyad de/

rje tai lo pa spyan drangs pa dang*/ rjes sprul pa'i dmag gis sgyu ma'i dmag thams cad bsad pas/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis tai lo par shes te/ chos la brten ba'i dam pa khyed// 'di ltar bya ru ga la rung*// zer ba la/ tai lo pas/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu bsad sogs la// sems med phyir na sdig pa med ces// gsungs pas/ dad pas gdam ngag zhus pa ste// bslu byed bden smra ha ha sgrogs// zhes zhal las shes par 'gyur// ༈ //chang tshong ma btul ba'i yon tan ni/ yang yul gcig tu chang 'tshong ma gcig gi can du phyin nas/ nged chang nyo bas chang khyer la shog byas pa dang*/ cha nyo ba rin ci yod zer ba la/ nyi grib mtshams su ri mo byas nas/ chang rin ri mo 'di 'das pa dang 'jal zer nas/ der res 'ga' byi lar sprul cing yang gsol/ res 'ga' rnal 'byor pa mang por sprul nas yang gsol/ res 'ga' rang nyid gcig pus gsol nas/ de'i chang 'tshong ma de las gzhan pa chang 'tshong ma bdun gyi chang zad par gsol nas/ de las chang rin zhus pas/ sngar gyi snod stong pa rnams su ltos gcig gsungs pas/ thams cad sngar bas mtho bar khengs par 'dug pas dad pa lhag par skyes nas/ gsol ba btab ste/ dam pa khyed ni gang nas byon// bdag cag rjes su bzung du gsol ces byas pas/ nga ni tai lo 'gro ba'i mgon// khyed kyis mthong byed rnal 'byor yin ces so// rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ gdams pa bstan pas/ de nyid skye ba de kho na la ye shes kyi dha ki mar gyur te/ chos la snang ba thob pas rnal 'byor mar gyur to// nyi 'od sgron ma so sa'i gling*/ rnal 'byor ma gang gha// ༈ //las rgyu 'bras don la rten 'brel dngos bstan pa ni/ mu stegs rgyang 'phen gyi lta ba 'dzin pa gcig gis/ yul khams gcig gi mi thams cad log lta la 'god pa'i tshe/ yang nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa gcig gis/ las rgyu 'bras bden pa'i 'dod pa'i sun phyungs/

yang gang rgyal shan ma phyed de/ gnyis ka'i dpang po thub pa ma phyung bas/ tai lo pas khong gnyis rtsod pa byed pa'i mdun na tshur 'ongs pas/ rtsod pa byas gang rgyal dris pas te lo pas rgyu 'bras yod pa rgyal bar byas/ 'o na khyed rang dang bya zer nas/ rtsod pa byas kyang lung rigs kyis kho sun ma phyin ste/ dngos su ma mthong bas mi bden zer ba la/ khyod rang mig tshums gcig byas nas se gol gcig gtogs pas/ dmyal ba'i gnas thams cad mthong ba dang*/ btso bsregs mang po nyams su myong ba mthong ba dang*/ zangs stong pa gcig gi nang na khro chu khol ma snang zhing mi mi snang nas/ 'di na med pa ci yin dris pas/ 'dir las rgyu 'bras med par 'dod pa'i mu stegs pa rgyu mi dge ba sna tshogs la spyad/ chos la lta ba log pas shi tsa na 'dir 'tshod pa yin zer bas yid ches so// 'on kyang mi dge ba spyad pas dmyal bar 'gro ba bden te/ dkar po'i rgyu 'bras med pas dge ba bsgrub mi dgos zer ba la/ ngas ston kyis 'dong gsungs nas/ skad cig gis lha'i yul sum cu rtsa gsum du khrid pa dang*/ lha'i gzhal yas khang re re'i nang na lha pho mo zung re 'dug pas/ khang pa gcig na lha mo rkyang gcig 'dug pa las/ 'di na gnyis med pa ci yin dris pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling na grub mtha' blos bsgyur rgyu 'bras yod pa gcig gis mi dge ba mang zhing*/ rgyu dge ba nyams su blangs pas 'dir skye ba yin zer ba dang*/ mu stegs de dad pa la/ las kyi 'phangs pa'i sdig can la// dmyal ba rang sems rang la 'khor// dge bcu spyod pa'i skyes bu la// bde 'gro rang sems rang la shar// ces snang ba rang sems su ngo sprad pa/ dge sdig gi rgyu 'bras bstan pas dad te/ chos zhus pas grol ba'i man tri dz+nya na ra lda ldi/ ces pa shar lho'o// ༈ //shan pa btul ba'i yon tan ni/ srog chags mang po gsod cing kho rang gi bu gcig yod pa la ster bas/

dus gcig gi tshe/ rje te lo pas gdul byar gzigs nas byon pa'i tshe/ shan pa zangs nang du srog chags mang po gsod pa'i sha rnams 'tshod pa la/ sha rnams la sprul skur byas te/ bu mi snang bar sbas nas/ sha de dag bu'i shar bsgyur ba dang kho rang gis zangs kha phyes nas bltas pa/ kho rang bur song nas bred nas ngus pa la/ rje tai lo pas/ sdig pa mi byed srog gcod spong na/ bu yod par bya gsungs pas/ der sdig pa spangs/ sngar byas pa bshags/ phyis mi byed par dam bcas pa dang der dad pas chos zhus pas grol ba ste/ las kyi byas pa'i sdig pa ni// 'bras bu rang la smin pa spangs// zhes gsungs te/ rjes su bas grol ba ni/ 'dzi na byang chub dpal kyi ri shes pa'o// ༈ //slob dpon chen po tai lo pas/ glu mkhan brtul ba'i yon tan ni/ yul khams gcig na glu mkhas pa gcig gis khrom chen po gcig la/ glu len cing 'dug la/ khyod ci la ngu byas pas/ kho khros pas glu kha byas pas/ kye ma zhes pa ni ngu ba'am/ mya ngan gyi tshig yin zhes gsungs/ glu 'gran pas/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i glu las ma shes/ rje btsun rgyal bas/ kho zil gyis mnan cing dad par gyur te/ rjes su gzung bar zhus pas/ dam pa khyed ni gang nas byon// nga ni khyed kyi zil gyis mnan zhus pas/ nga ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas// 'dir 'ongs gsungs dbyangs yan lag mkhan// skyong gi glu mkhan te lo yin/ da lta phyogs med yul du 'gro gsungs pas/ dbyangs ldan kugs pa na ga ra/ ces pa'o// ༈ //nus pa mkhan brtul ba'i yon tan ni/ mthu bo che nyi ma zhes bya ba la/ mi rnams thams cad 'dud dgos pas/ sdang ba thams cad 'chi bar byed la/ nye 'khor ba yang 'tsher kam me ba gcig yod pa la/ te lo pas kho'i drung du song nas/ sdang ba'i lta tshul gcig byas pas/ khyod la ngas mthu byed ces zer nas mthu byas te/ chos skyong mi sdug pa'i tshogs byung tshad/

lta stangs kyis bsad/ kho'i 'khor byung tshad kyang lta stangs kyis bsad/ kho shin tu sdug bsngal bar byung ste gnas pa la/ rje tai lo pa drung du byon nas/ byams pa'i lta stangs byas pa la/ kho dga' ba la/ phyis sdig pa mi byed na/ gso thabs yod gsungs pas/ kho rang la 'khor shi ba thams cad rnam shes bkugs nas gtad pas/ shin tu dad de/ rje tai lo pas/ don rtogs rnal 'byor tai lo ngas/ bsad pa zhes bya gcig kyang med/ ces gsungs pas/ grol te/ nyi ma i mi tsun dhi'i gling zhes pa'o// ༈ //dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i sprul par grags pa'i yon tan ni/ chu bo sa la na sti dang*/ du la ke twa ra yi 'gram/ dur khrod 'bar ba 'dzin pa kyi rtsa/ gtsug lag khang su la kha tre zhes bya bar/ mya ngan med pa'i tshal du/ tai lo pa rab tu byung ste/ dge slong gi bslabs pa mnos nas/ ming yang dge slong gha la bha zhes kyang grags so// gnas de na khrims su bya ba la/ snga dro so so'i brang khang du bsgoms shing bsam gtan byed/ phyi dro skor ba dang chos spyod thun mong du lha gang du byed pa la/ de la mi mthun pa byas na chad pas gcod pa las/ ka la bha de las bzlogs nas/ snga dro lam ka gcig tu srog chags mang po bsad pas 'go lus phral nas phyogs so sor spungs/ chang 'tshong ma'i chang sbang ma 'bu red pa rnams zhal bkang zhing gsol bas/ zhang po gnas brtan zla 'od gzhon nu ma bzod nas/ gzhan gyi mthong na chad pa chen po gcod pas/ nye ring byed nyen yod pas zer nas/ lkog tu mkhan slob 'tshogs nas gros byas pas/ ka la bha la gros ma btabs nas/ gso sbyong mi 'chags pas nged gros byed zer du 'ongs gsungs nas gros btabs pas/ de ltar byed shing ma nyan pas slar la mang du bsad do// lan gcig gi tshe rgyal po dus mchod la byung ba'i lam ka na/ de ltar byed shing 'dug pas ma dad pa la/ rgyal pos lo rgyus dris pa'i lan du/ gnas zhi mya ngan med tshal du// mkhan slob ma dang zhang po yin// nga rang dge slong ka la bha// skal pa bye ba phrag brgya ru// rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang*// klu sgrub ar+ya de ba dang*// rdo rje 'chang dang nga gtam byas// nga ni zhing khams brgyar yang phyin// sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal yang mthong*// sa rab dga' ba ngas kyang mthong*/

rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bden pa mthong*// chos nyid chos sku mngon du gyur// sa ra ha ni chen pos kyang*// nga la rtog pa 'gran du med// ngas ni sems can bsad pa med// ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas/ se gol gcig btabs pas srog chags thams cad 'go lus 'byar te/ 'od dang bcas nas 'phur nas song ba'o// 'di ni bde mchog 'khor lo'i sprul pa yin par 'dug pas/ zhes khong du chud nas de ltar du grags so// ༈ //bde mchog 'khor lo dngos su bstan pa'i yon tan ni/ 'di yi dus su rgyal po'i seng ge zla ba'i pho brang gi mdun na phar byon pas/ bsod snyoms kyi lam byed cing*/ dang por rtogs/ bar du bsnyen bkur byed/ tha ma spyod lam ci byed dang chos ci 'dug dris pa'i gnas skabs su// lan gcig rgyal pos lha khang steng nas bltas pas/ dge slong zhi ba dul ba spyod lam mdzes pa gcig 'dug nas/ rgyal pos mthong ba dang*/ spyod pa brtag pa dang*/ slob dpon mdo rgyud snga na med pa mang po 'don zhing*/ mchod gnas paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa gcig gis brtag pas kyang*/ mdo 'don sngar thos ma myong ba ngo mtshar can du 'dug pas/ der rgyal po dad pas/ spyan drangs zhing chos ston ni nyi ma mang du drangs pa dang*/ rgyal po la chos dang mthun pa'i smon lam btabs nas song bas/ yang yang chos ston la spyan drangs so// dus res shig gi tshe/ rgyal pos lo rgyus zhib tu dris te/ zhus pa las/ nga ni pha dang ma bral ba'i// bram ze rigs kyi tai lo yin// nga la mkhan slob yongs med de// nga ni rang byung sangs rgyas yin// nga ni bshad nyan ma bslabs ste// sgra tshad rig pa rang rdol yin// bde mchog sku gsung thugs dang ni// nga ni dbyer med brjod du med// zhes pas 'di yi dus bde mchog 'khor lo dngos su grags so// dus res zhig na/ rgyal po me tog gling pa zhes bya ba de slob dpon la dad nas/

mos pa byas shing gsol ba btabs pas/ rje tai lo pas kyang rjes su bzungs ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ ku su li mang po dang dus gcig tu tshogs 'khor gyi gtso bo zhus nas gsol ba btabs pas/ zang zing de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor tha dad pa'i snang ba byung ste/ ma mthun pa la/ nga'i lus ni kye'i rdo rje la// ngag ni ma hā ma ya yin// sems ni 'khor lo bde mchog ste// dbang po gsang ba 'dus pa yin// yan lag sgra rgyud nag po yin// nying lag rdo rje 'jigs byed yin// rtsa gnas rdo rje gdan bzhi la// rlung gnas rdo rje phreng ba yin// thig le gsang ba mdzod yin te// gtsug tor sangs rgyas thod pa yin// thams cad bdag nyid dus 'khor lo// bde chen sangs rgyas mnyam par sbyor// ba spu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med yin// ces gsungs te/ gtsug gi nor bu'i dgon par gshegs pa la/ rnal 'byor pa de rnams thams cad kyis dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo yin par 'dug zhes grags so// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor bsdus te/ bstan pa'i yon tan bstan pa'o// ༈ //sangs rgyas dngos kyi sprul pa 'gro ba'i mgon// sgrol mas byin rlabs ming ni tai lo pa// shes rab lnga ldan shes rab bzang po zhes// gsang ba'i mtshan ni bde mchog rdo rje dang*// rtogs med rdo rje bde ba'i 'khor lo zhes/ ka la bha zhes grags pa'i bla ma bde ba bzang po ni// til gyi zhabs zhes grags pa'i 'chi med sku// rnal 'byor dbang phyug de'i zhabs la bdud// te lo pa'i rnam thar rdzogs so/// // ༈ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun kyi bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*// byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po dang*/ dbyer med rnal 'byor dbang phyug tai lo pa// shar phyogs za hor yul du sku 'khrungs te// til brdung las la brtson par gnyis med kyi/

(yig chung yin nam snyam/) /ye shes dngos po gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shar gyi za hor yul phyogs lan gsum du stong par byed pa sprul pa rdo rje'i sku nub phyogs u rgyan yul du byon nas kyang dharma gha dzha gsang ba'i gha dho'i/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rnam gsum la// gsang ba dri med gdams pa rnam gsum dang*// chos don ston pa rgyud don mtha' dag zhus// dngos grub thob nas gdul bya'i don du byon// lus med gdams pa khong du chud nas ni// phyi rab don du nges par gzhan don phyir// bla ma bsten cing dka' babs brgyud par ldan// 'di dag gnas kyi nges pa dang*// dus dang gdul bya lam la bkod// rim pa bzhin du bstan pa ni// rje btsun chen po tai lo pas// gdul bya'i gtso bo rnam brgyad btul// nus ldan blo gros u rgyan yul// rtsa rlung ye shes de nyid rang grol bstan// nag po dge ba bsil ba'i tshal// ma nor lam gyi gzer drug bstan// bslu byed bden smra ha ha dgod// sgyu ma rten 'brel snying po bstan// nyi 'od sgron ma so yi gling*// lhan cig skyes pa'i mngon rtog nyid// 'dzin na byang chub dpal kyi ri// dri med bde ba'i lam mchog bstan// man dh+ri dzha na ra lda lding*// phyi nang gsang ba'i rgyu 'bras bstan// nyi zla a mi tsu ta'i gling*// rnam rtog rang dag man ngag bstan// dkugs pa dbyangs mkhan na ga ra// lta bsgoms spyod pa'i gdams pa ste// skal ldan de dag re rer yang*// skad cig nyid la grol gyur te// 'byung ba'i skye mched dbang thob nas// 'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob ste// 'das pa med par bzhugs pa yin// sku lus spyod pa rnam 'gyur yang*// sna tshogs du mar ston pa ni// gdul bya sna tshogs drangs ba'i phyir// nges pa med pa'i tai lo pa// dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo yi// sprul par grags pa'i dus tshod ni// chu bo sa la na ti'i 'am// du la ke ti'i zhes pa'i 'gram// pu la khe tra mya ngan med// rab byung tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i tshe// dang po bden pa mthong dus su// rtsa ba'i skus ni 'og min du// rdo rje 'chang la chos gsan te// rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang*// klu sgrub ar+ya de ba dang*// rdo rje 'chang dang nga gtam byas// ngas ni zhing khams brgyar yang phyin// sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya byung*// sa rab dga' ba ngas kyang mthong*// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bden pa mthong*// sa ra ha ni chen pos kyang*// rtogs pa nga la 'gran du med// grub thob nam mkha'i mthar thug pas// bstod pa 'os su gyur pa yin// te lo pa la rtog pa med// sems can skye med gnas su dengs// gzung 'dzin rtog pas 'chings 'gyur pas// dbyer med nam mkha'i rdzong la ltos//

༈ //bde mchog dngos su grags pa ni/ rgyal po zla srungs gdul bya la// he ru ka yi cha byad kyis// rnam thar sgo gsum sku gsung thugs// shri he ru kar gyur pa nyid// rang byung sangs rgyas nyid du bstan// dus gsum sangs rgyas phyogs bcu yi// dkyil 'khor tha dad bstan pa ni// rgyal po me tog gling pa'i don// sna tshogs du ma'i lha ru sprul// nga'i lus ni kye'i rdo rje la// ngag ni ma hā ma ya ni// sems ni 'khor lo bde mchog ste// dbang po gsang ba 'dus pa yin// yan lag sgra rgyud nag po ste// nying lag rdo rje 'jigs byed yin// rtsa gnas rdo rje gdan bzhi la// rlung gnad rdo rje 'phreng ba yin// thig le gsang ba mdzod yin te// gtsug tor sangs rgyas thod pa yin// thams cad bdag nyid dus 'khor lo// bde chen sangs rgyas mnyam par sbyor// rang sems lhan cig skyes pa nyid// skad cig dang por rang byung ba// ma skyes 'das pa'i sangs rgyas yin// skad gcig gnyis la 'gag pa ni// mi skye ma byon sangs rgyas yin// skad cig gsum pa lhun gyis grub// skye med da ltar sangs rgyas yin// ba spu zhing khams dpag med kyi// de dag sangs rgyas dus gsum kyi// sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med yin// bdag nyid chen po gcig nyid ni// sangs rgyas du mar sangs rgyas dang*// sangs rgyas du ma sna tshogs la// bdag nyid gcig tu sangs rgyas pa'o// mi brjed gzungs thob dpal ldan na ro dang*// bde chen ye shes don ldan ka so ri// snang ba lam du slong ba'i ri ri pa// mchog gi slob ma rnams gsum gdul bya ste// kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes ste// 'di ni byin rlabs rim pa bla na med// te lo nga yis ci yang bstan du med// rang rig nyid la mtshon te shes par byas// ༈ //nus ldan blo gros u rgyan yul du btul// de la spyod pa mthu stobs can zhes grags// nag po dge ba bsil ba'i tshal du ste// nag po dur khrod pa zhes grags pa'o// bden bar smra ba ha ha dgod// kong ka li pa zhes bya ba'o// chang 'tshong so so'i gling du ste// rnal 'byor ma ni gha gha'o// rngon pa dpal kyi ri 'dab tu// 'gu na sa gang ra pa zhes pa'o// man tri se tra ra lda ste// gcer bu lhung bzed 'dzin par 'gyur// nyi zla a mi tsu ta'i gling*// nyi ma sbas pa zla ba sbas// na ga tar ni glu mkhan la// mdung byung dkugs pa zhes byar grags// 'di dag gdul bya'i gtso bo'i ste// snyan rgyud gdams pas smin cing grol// rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyad po 'di// nges pa rdo rje'i sku thob pa// rje btsun te lo chen po la// lus med mkha' 'gros gdams pa ni// spyod pa chu la ral gri rgyob// dam tshig rang sems me long ltos// dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma gsal// smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud khrol// rang grol phyag rgya chen po ltos// rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo skor// rig pa ye shes sgron me sbor// ro snyoms phyi'i me long shar// bde chen gsung gi rin chen chongs// gsang ba dri med mkha' 'gro mas// brda don bstan pa rdo rje'i tshig

/gsungs pas ma 'ongs skal ldan don// ye shes chen po rtogs gyur pa'o// rje btsun chen po te lo pa// shes rab bzang po'i rnam par thar pa bsdus pa'o// // ༈ //dpal ldan lhan cig skyes pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// nus ldan btul ba'i yon tan ni// bde ba la zhen rtsa rlung sbyang gyur pas// snang ba thogs med mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs// khams 'dus lha yi dkyil 'khor zhen pa yis// don dam gnyug ma'i gnas lugs rtogs mi 'gyur// gnas lugs rtogs par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rlung bcing la sogs lha'i rgya mdud de// zhen med gnyug ma'i ngang du rang sar grol lo// bde chen 'bad rtsol med pa ngang gis 'char// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// spang bya gnyen po'i chos rnams kun// rang gi sems su 'dus pas na// de phyir rang sems sgom par bya// bsgoms pa'i tshe na ci yang sgom rgyu med// sgom du med pa mi sgom dbang med pa// gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin// bdag dang gzhan don 'bras bu phun gsum tshogs// tai lo nga yis ci yang bstan du med// nus ldan blo gros u rgyan yul du'o// ༈ //slob dpon chen po te lo pas// rnal 'byor nag po dge ba la gdams pa// las dang rnal 'byor rten 'brel gyis// mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran// yang dag lam du zhugs pa la// gzer drug gnad kyi gdams pa dgos// ces pas de la gzer drug la// gsol ba 'debs par byed pa la// skyabs 'gro byin rlabs kyi gzer// rig pa srangs su 'dzud par byed pa la// srog rtsol gnad kyi gzer// gnas lugs rtogs par byed pa las/ gnyug ma ngo sprod kyi gzer/ de nyid nyams su blangs pas/ nyams myongs rtags kyi gzer/ myur du sangs rgyas par 'dod pas/ 'pho ba gnad kyi gzer/ bem rig phral ba'i dus su/ dha ka ye shes kyi gzer dang drug go

/dang po la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro rten bskyed pa dang*/ dngos gzhi skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ rjes gnas lugs la blo bzhag pa'o// sngon 'gro rten bskyed pa la/ rang tha mal du stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ byang chub kyi sems dran pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi spyi bo'i steng du 'dom gang tsam du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ pad+ma 'dab ma stong du ldan pa gcig bsam/ de'i dbus kyi lte ba la/ yi dam gyi lha jo mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ snang la rang bzhin med pa bsam/ de'i dbu'i steng khru gang tsam du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la/ seng ge'i khri dang*/ nyi zla dang bcas pa la/ de'i steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bsam/ de'i steng khru gang tsam pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi lte ba dang bcas pa la/ bde mchog gsang ba rin po che yab yum/ de rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ la sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ eṭa baṃ dang hūm̐ la sngags kyi bskor bar bsam/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sprin dpung gtibs pa bzhin du bsam/ rje btsun ma'i phyogs bzhir rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi/ bla ma'i phyogs bzhir/ tsar+ya pa/ klu sgrub/ la ba pa/ skal pa bzang mo bzhi/ lhan skyes phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bsam par bya/ de rnams kyang rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa/ nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu'o// de ni rten bskyed pa'o// skyabs su 'gro ba la bdag dang sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzungs nas/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rtogs pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// ces ngag tu ci rigs par bya'o// de nas rang gi baṃ dang sngags la/ 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phog /de nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yab yum gyi thugs kar phog pas/

yab yum las bdud rtsi byang sems kyi rgyun babs pas bla ma la phog /de la bab pas yi dam lha la phogs/ de la bab pas rang gi spyi bor babs pas/ phyi na mar song bas phyi lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /nang na mar song bas nang sems kyi sdig sgrib dag /de'i ngang la rang yi dam gyi lha dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ nyams myong mtshan nyid gsum lhan cig tu bkra lam gyis bsam/ lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la ngo sprad pa dang*/ bum pa'i dbang la ngo sprad pa'o// de nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ de'i ngang la rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūṃ/ bsam pa'i ngang las hūṃ ci rigs par bgrang zhig hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ yi dam lha'i thugs kar phog /de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma'i thugs kar phog /de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde mchog yab yum la phog /de la phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi mchod pas mchod/ phyi'i mchod pa lnga/ nang gi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba zag med bde ba gsum gyis mchod/ de nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ yab kyi thugs ka nas hūṃ/ yab yum gyi thugs ka nas baṃ/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros pa las/ yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs shing bskyod pas/ rdo rje dang pad+ma gnyis bsrubs pa dang sbyor mtshams nas/ bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun bab pas/ rang gi lce thog tu si li li babs pas/ rang gi rtsa bo che dang rtsa bran thams cad khengs pas/ zag med kyi bde bas bde pri li li bsam/ de'i ngo bo gsang dbang ngo*// bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa la ngo sprad pas/ de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// rjes gnas lugs la blo bzhag pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos drug /'gyu ba rlung gi gnad la/ rlung rang sor gzhag /sems kyi gnad la sems ma bcos par gzhag /de'i rgyun sgom pa/ de la tshigs dbang rin po che zer/ de ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang dbang bzhi dang sbyar ba'o// de ni gsol ba 'debs pa la skyabs 'gro byin rlabs kyi gzer zhes bya'o//

༈ //rig pa srang du 'dzud pa la/ srog rtsol gnad kyi gzer bu la bdun/ bskyed pa sems kyi gnad/ bca' thabs lus kyi gnad/ gnas pa rtsa'i gnad/ 'gyu ba rlung gi gnad/ dmigs pa rten kyi gnad/ bkod pa byang chub sems kyi gnad/ nyams myong rtags kyi gnad do// dang po ni byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dran pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rkang pa ril li mig ltar bsnol/ sgal tshigs bsrangs/ dpung pa brkyangs/ a lo skos skol ol mdud mnan/ mnyam bzhag phyag rgya btsir/ yi dam lha gsal bas/ brang la gsus pa sbyar ro// gsum pa ni/ rtsa a ba dhu ti/ yar sna spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga la zug /mar sna gsang ba'i rdo rjer zug /ro rkyang gnyis yar sna sna sgor zug /mar sna spu ne gu mtshams su'o// bzhi pa ni brngub pa/ zhi ba/ dgang ba/ gtang ba/ klod pa'o// lnga pa la/ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdo ru/ me rgya khab tsam la/ sems 'dzin pa'o// drug pa ni/ pha las thob pa'i/ spyi bo nas zla ba/ ma las thob pa'i rak+ta nyi ma gsum mdo na gnas/ de gnyis bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med par gnas pa'o// bdun pa ni/ nyams myong la/ bde ba dang*/ gsal ba dang*/ mi rtog pa'o// rtags la rtags lnga/ phan yon brgyad la sogs pa/ rlung lnga zin pa'i rtags 'char ba'o// de ni srog dang rtsol ba'o// gnas lugs rtogs par 'dod pas/ gnyug ma ngo sprod kyi gzer la gsum/ chos nyid gtan la dbab pa dang*/ sems nyid gtan la dbab pa dang*/ gnyis su med cing gnyug ma'i don la blo bzhag pa'o// nyams myongs rtags kyi gzer la/ bde gsal mi rtog pa rgyun kyi dag pa'i dri ma med par mthar phyin pa'o// rtags la mtha' bzhi rang grol lta ba'i rtags// ma sgom yengs med sgom pa/ rang byung 'gag med spyod pa/ rang shar lhun grub 'bras bu/ re dogs med pa'i rtags so// myur du sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i 'pho ba'i gdam ngag lam blo chod/ khyad par gyi gzer la gnad bzhi las/

bca' thabs lus kyi gnad dang*/ 'pho ba yul gi gnad dang*/ gtad thabs dmigs pa'i gnad dang*/ 'gyu ba rlung gi gnad do// dang po ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos drug go /'pho sa yul gyi gnad la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gzhon zhing mdzes pa/ lo bcu drug tsam lon pa/ nu ma dang gsang gnas tshun chad gsal ba/ rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa de'i thugs ka nas/ me tog pad+ma kha bye ba lta bu'i zel bu la/ yi ge baṃ dmar mo 'bur du btod pa lta bu la/ sngags kyis bskor ba/ de ni 'pho sa yul gyi gnad do// gtad thabs dmigs pa'i gnad la/ rang gi rtsa a ba dhu ti de'i yar sna tshangs pa'i bu gar zug /mar sna gsang gnas su zug /de yang sbom phra mda' smyug tsam/ smyug ma lta bur bsam/ de'i rtsa gsum mdo der yi ge hūṃ gcig bsam/ tshangs pa'i bu gar k+sha bsam pas/ de yar phyes nas tshangs bug phyes nas/ yod par bsam gyis/ steng rlung mnan la 'og rlung 'then la/ hūṃ de jo mo'i bha ga nas yar song ste/ thugs ka'i baṃ la tims kyis thim par bsam/ de'i ngang las dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs dang*/ rang gi sems nyid dbyer med du bsam/ de'i ngang las sangs rgyas pa'o// ༈ //bem rig dbul ba'i dus su dha ye shes la/ dha ka la snang ba'i thim tshul dang*/ ye shes rtogs pa'i mchar tshul dang*/ skyel bsu ci ltar 'byung ba'o// dang po 'byung bzhi thim pas phyi dbugs chad pa'i dus so// gnyis pa ni nang dbugs en tsam gcig ma chad pa'i dus der/ pha las thob pa'i thig le ni spyi bo nas bskyod/ ma las thob pa rtsa gsum mdo nas bskyod de/ snying kar gnyis 'joms nas 'od gsal shar nas sangs rgyas pa'o// yang skyel bsu gnyis ngo 'phrod nas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan nam rtsal ka thams cad der rdzogs nas sangs rgyas gsung ngo*// der gzer drug gi gdams pa'o// nag po dge ba bsil ba'i tshal na rdo rje'i sku thob nas bzhugs pa'o// slob dpon chen po tai lo pas sgyu ma mkhan btul ba ni/

kye bslu byed sgyu ma mkhan btul bzhin/ snang srid sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la// dug gsum sgyu ma'i zhen pa thong*// zhen med sgyu ma'i snying po bsgoms// snang srid sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor pa// sems nyid nam mkha'i ngang du zhogs// 'das dang ma 'ongs 'khor 'das bral ba yi// rang byung lhan cig skyes par byas// yang dag kun rdzob rang bzhin las// rgyu 'bras nam mkha' rang bzhin can// mi gnas bde ba chen po de// dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa yin// yid bzhin nor 'dra chos nyid dgos 'dod 'byung*// tai lo nga yis ci yang bstan du med// ces gsungs pas/ 'gro mgon bdud rtsi chu rgyun 'thungs pa yis// bla med don gyi snying po bdag gis rtogs// 'ja' tshon nam mkha' nor bu sems la shar// da ni su la yang dri bar mi bya'o// bden par smra ba ha ha dgod// ༈ //na mo rat+na gu ru/ chang 'tshong ma la gdams pa/ dad ldan dbang dang dam tshig dang*// bsgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dur khrod la sogs nyams dga' bar// stan bde ba la 'dug sems bskyed la/ rang nyid lhar bsam baṃ 'od las// bla ma dang la spyan drangs la// phyag sogs yan lag bdun pa bya// de rjes sngags 'di bzla bar bya/ ā+oṃ sa bha ba'i sngags so// de'i ngang las stong par bsam// de'i ngang las lha mo ni// khams gsum rgya che gzhal yas khang*// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor bsam// de yi lte bar chos 'byung bsam// gdan sogs rim par bskyed par bya// ro yi snying kar rang sems ni// baṃ yig dmar mo bsam par bya// 'od zer 'phro 'dus lha bskyed de// zhabs gnyis gar thabs brkyang bskum bzhugs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa// g.yas pa gri gug nam mkhar phyar// g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin// kha tam rim par rgyan bzhin mdzes// gcer bu sku mdog dmar mor bsgom/ gnas gsum byin rlabs go cha bgos// ye shes bstim la dbang bskur mchod// skyo na sngags kyi 'khor lo bskor// de rjes bha ling 'phrin las bya// rten can rten med rdzogs rim sgom// nyi 'od sgron ma so sa'i gling du'o//

༈ //slob dpon chen po tai lo pas/ rngon pa 'dzi na la gdams pa/ lus ngag yid gsum mi dge 'gyod pa yis// mi dge spang zhing dge bcu dang du blangs// yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gi gdung ba 'joms// skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub sems bskyed de// bu chung ltar gnas 'dzub kyis zla mthong bzhin// chu bo rgyun bzhin de nyid goms pa las// nyi zla'i 'od dang 'od zer gnyis su med// dpag bsam shing dang bum pa yid bzhin du'o// 'dzi na byang chub dpal gyi ri'o// gzungs 'dzin gnyis kyi nags tshal stug po na// ma rigs rtogs pa'i ri dwags rgyu ba dag nyams myong dri med ye shes rtogs pa'i bdas// bde chen phyag rgya chen pos bsgral// slob dpon chen po te lo pas// man tri 'dzi na nam mkha' spyod kyi// mu stegs ston pa man tri yis// rgyu 'bras med par 'dod pa yi/ chad par lta ba bsal ba'i phyir/ de yi don du gsungs pa 'di// rten 'brel rnam pa bzhi ru gsungs/ phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*/ kho na nyid dang rnam pa bzhi// rgyu 'bras dngos su bstan pa lags// phyi yi rgyu 'bras thal nas ni// nang gi rgyu 'bras 'di lta ste// rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs la// lus kyi rgyu ni rtsa yin ste// ngag ni yi ge sems thig le// gsum la khyab pa rlung yin no// de bzhin rgyu dang 'bras bu ni// mngon sum ston par byed pa las// gnad ni rnam pa bzhi yin te// lus dang rtsa dang yul dang dmigs// rlung ni gnad dang bzhi ru 'dus// dang por bca' thabs lus kyi gnad// rkang pa rdo rje dkyil mo krung*// bsam gtan yan lag lnga sbyor bas// rang bzhin med pa'i lha ru bsgoms// de ni lus kyi gnad yin no// rtsa yi gnad ni 'di lta ste// 'khor lo bzhi ni gnas bzhi'i ru// skad cig gis ni tsakra bzhi// rnam pa tsam ni wal kyi bsam// rtsa gsum mtshan nyid bstan pa ni// gsal bar bsgom zhing lam du bya// de ni rtsa yi gnad yin no// dmigs pa'i rten ni 'di lta ste// spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo na/

tshangs phug haṃ dkar 'og thur bltas// lte 'og sor bzhi gcal ba na// shes rab a dmar gyen la lta// de nas sbyor bzhi rlung bsgoms pas// a las me 'bar haṃ la reg /byang chub sems ni a la thim// de ltar bsgoms par gyur pa las// 'bras bu bskyed pa'i rim pa ni// rtsa kha bye bas rtsa mdud grol// thig le 'phel zhing bde ba rgyas// bde ba'i ngo bo mi rtog pa// de gsum dbyer med lhan cig skyes// 'du 'bral med par chos sku 'char// nang gi rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ni// dngos su bstan pa'i gdams ngag la// gnad ni bdun du shes par bya// byang chub sems kyi bde ba ni// dbabs bskyil bzlogs 'dzin drang ba dang*// bkram dang khyab bya gzhag pa rnams// ngo sprad bla ma'i zhal las shes// lus ngag yid gsum 'khrul 'khor ni// dad gus rten 'brel gnad rnams ni// mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhal las shes// de kho na nyid kyi rgyu 'bras la// rgyu ni dngos po'i gnas lugs la// mtshan ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// skad cig nyid la chos sku 'char// rgyu 'bras dngos su bstan pa'o// mu stegs ston pa la gdams pa'o/// / ༈ //slob dpon chen po tai lo pas/ mthu mkhan la gdams pa/ sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes can// re dogs mthar 'dzin dug gi dkris shing gis// lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin gnas der bcing*// lhan cig skyes pa'i gnas lugs dri ma med// de nyid yod pa sus kyang shes pa med// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde ba thob 'dod pas// lo 'dab steng du rdo rje dkyil krung chos// nor bu rin chen ljon shing rtse dang dbus// sprel gyi spyan 'bras gyen la bzlog par bya// gzung 'dzin rang grol don gyi snying po ltos// las zin pa yi skyes bu mkhas pa bzhin// lus ngag yid gsum gnyugs ma'i ngang du zhog /me long g.ya' dag bu ram nor bu bzhin// ces tai lo pas gsungs pas/

mthu can gyis/ lam gyi mchog gyur bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// nyon mongs dug la sngags bzhin chos kyi sku// nam mkha'i klong nas nor bu'i 'od zer shar// 'gro drug sems can bu bzhin cis mi bzung*// zer te grol nas rdo rje'i sku thob pa// nyi zla a mi tsu ta'i gling*// ༈ //na mo rat+na na gu ru/ slob dpon chen po tai lo pas/ glu mkhan dbyangs ldan la gdams pa/ gang tshe lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa la// grub mtha'i rtog pa sna tshogs sprin 'dus kyang*// brjod med ngag gi 'brug sgra sgrogs byas la// mi gnas bde chen gnas lugs ye shes rang lugs zhog /bsgoms pa chos rnams kun dang ro gcig pa// chu bran rgya mtsho chen por thim pa bzhin// rang byung rang zhi sna tshogs chos nyid na// dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje lta bu'i// spyod pa rang byung tshogs drug lhug pa nyid// bu chung smyon pa gdol pa'i spyod pa bzhin// snang srid chos la spang blangs med/ zhen med sgyu ma lta bur spyad par bya// nyams myongs dri med bde stong rgyun chad med// mi rtogs mi dmigs chu'o rgyun bzhin du// lus sems snang ba tha dad med pa'i don// dri med lhun grub rtogs pa'i rtsol ba med// 'bras bu rang grol 'khor 'das dbyer mi byed// sku gsum logs su med pa rang gi sems// yon tan 'phrin las byang chub sems kyis 'byung*// rtsol med gter chen mi zad 'khor lor 'char// 'di dag mthar thug chos rnams kun kyi bcud// bdud rtsi yi chu rgyun dbyangs ldan brjod med pa// rnal 'byor khyed la te lo ngas bshad gang*// rang rig rang la mtshon te shes par byos// bla ma'i byin rlabs bde chen nyi ma'i 'od// shar gyur mun sel blo'i pad+ma kha dbye ba// skal ldan khyod kyis de ltar shes gyis la// te lo nga yis ci yang bstan du med// ces gdams so// lta ba gnyis su med par gtan la dbab pa dang*/

bsgoms pa yengs su med par gnyis su blangs ba dang*/ spyod pa lhun grub tshogs drug lhug par gzhag pa dang 'bras bu re dogs med par gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ ngo bo gnyis su med pa rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ mtshan nyid 'gag pa med pa'o// gnyis pa la gzhag thabs rnam pa gsum la brten nas/ rang byung gi ye shes ngos bzung ba'o// bzhag thabs rnams gsum ni/ rnam rtog rang sar grol ba sbrul mdud ltar gzhag /rnam rtog 'gro 'ong rgyun chad med pa/ chu'i rgyun chad pa'i rang tag ltar/ rig pa 'bad rtsol med par rtogs pa gcig gis sa chod pa/ bya rgod nam mkha' la lding ba ltar gzhag go /de las nyams su 'char ba ni/ gsal la rtog pa med pa mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu'i nyams/ gsal la mtha' spang pa ston ka'i nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu'i nyams/ spang blang med pa chu nang gi zla ba lta bu'i nyams 'char ro// spyod pa la gsum ste/ zhe sdang lam du slong ba la snying rje kun tu spyod pa dang*/ 'dod chags lam du slong ba la bde ba'i kun tu spyod pa dang*/ gti mug rang sar dag pas/ dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa bde chen du spyod pa'o// ༈ //'bras bu ni/ re dogs med pa sems rang bzhin gyis stong pa 'od gsal du rtogs pas chos sku/ de'i ngo bo zag pa med pa bde ba chen por shar ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku de nyid kyi ngang la thugs rje chen po ma 'gag par shar ba sprul pa'i sku'o// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i lta bsgoms spyod pa'i gdams ngag /dbyangs ltan lkugs pa na ga ra/ ces so// rje btsun chen po te lo pa'i snyan rgyud brgyad gdams pa'o/// // ༈ lus srog ltos pa med par ni// bla ma dam pa bsten mdzad cing*// rdo rje sku thob rnal 'byor pa// dpal ldan na ro'i zhabs la 'dud// de la rje na ro pa la yon tan dpag tu med cing brjod kyi mi langs pa dang*/

mdor bsdus na bzhi ste/ de la phyi lung bstan brda don bkrol ba dang*/ gsang ba gces 'phangs 'bul byed kyi dka' ba la brten nas/ thabs kyi sgron me bltam pa/ de kho na nyid bka' nyan gsung sdod kyi dka' ba la brten nas/ 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'o// de re re la yang gnyis gnyis te/ snod ldan rigs kyi che ba dang*/ lung bstan rtogs pa che ba gnyis/ smon lam dbang gis mthong phye ba dang*/ grol lam thabs kyi sgron me bltam pa dang gnyis/ bde ba'i sgron me sbar ba dang*/ zag pa med pa'i sgron me sbar ba dang*/ spyod pa la rtags thon pa dang*/ 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa gnyis te/ zung bzhi ya brgyad kyis 'chad par byed do// de la dang po ni/ de yang rgya gar kasmi ra zhes bya ba'i rgyal khams kyi grong khyer 'bum phrag 'ga' zhig gi dbus/ 'dod pa'i yon tan yongs su rgyas pa/ rgyal po'i pho brang*/ 'khor glang po dang*/ shing rta dang*/ rta'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba/ skyed mos tshal dang*/ 'bangs ris su bcas pa/ der yang rgyal po dge ba'i go ca zhes bya ba dang*/ btsun mo dpal kyi blo gros ma gnyis la/ sras mo dpal kyi ye shes ma bya ba byung*/ der sras kyis dben nas/ bla ma dang*/ dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ sems can la sbyin gtong rgya chen po mdzad/ rten khyad par can thams cad la yang mchod pa byas pa dang*/ sras kyis gsol ba btab pas/ rgyal gyi zla ba la sras gcig btsas nas/ shin tu mtshan dang ldan can byung ste/ bram ze mtshan mkhan la mtshan bstan pas/ 'di ni zas gtsang sras bzhin du// khyi gnas mi'i bdag po la// byung nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa yi// tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes lung bstan te/ rgyal po kun tu bzang po zhes bya bar mtshan btags so// de shin tu skyed che bar byung ste/ rang bzhin gyis yon tan du ma dang ldan par gnas pa la/ yab kyis khyim nas ni med par/ rgyal srid spangs te rab tu byung gis dogs nas/

yi ge la sogs pa slob tu mi ster nas/ yab yum gyi ma tshor bar bslabs nas/ tshegs med par shes so// rgyal bu rab tu byung bar 'dod pa la/ yab kyis ma gnang ba la/ chos la ma brten ci byas dag /sdug bsngal yin phyir dam chos nyan// ces gsungs nas/ bram ze'i slob dpon 'phags pa'i nam mkha' bya ba la/ chos mang du gsan te/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par bslabs nas/ dge bsnyen mdzad de/ mtshan yang nam mkha'i snying por btags so// de nas paṇ+ḍi ta bcu gsum tsam khrid nas/ pha ma can du 'ongs pa la pha ma de dag chos byed pa la mi dga' bas/ yab na re/ pha ma dkon mchog rang bzhin la// brtse ba'i yid kyis ma nyan pas// rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal bzhin spangs// pha mas ma gnang dam chos chi// khyim gyi gnas su bzhugs su gsol// zer nas/ khab tu bzhugs la rgyal srid skyong dgos ces zer ba la/ nā ro pas/ 'gro drug pha ma'i rang bzhin la// gcig gnyis pha mar nges med kyang*// rtogs med gtsang sbra la gnas shing*// mu stegs dri bral theg chen rigs// rnyed na bdag la bka' stsol cig /gsungs pas/ yab thugs mi bde ba la/ blon pos dris pas/ sras la btsun mo de lta bu mi rnyed pas dri ba la/ blon po na re/ kye rgyal po chen po lags/ de la thugs ngal ma mdzad cig /'jig rten khams 'di rgya che yang*// dri ma med pa btsal bas rnyed zer na// rngan pa gser mang po sbyin par byas nas tshol du btangs pas/ shar phyogs bha gha la nas/ bram ze skar rgyal yi sras mo/ dri ma med zhes rnyed nas/ rgyal bu'i khab tu blangs nas/ slob mar byas nas yod pa la/ rgyal bu skyo ba skyes nas/ dri med ma dang gros byas/ chos kyi bar chad mi bya bar byas// bud med skyon ni sna tshogs pas// g.yo sgyu dug gi 'dam rdzab tu// rang sems glang po byings gyur pas// de bas bdag ni rab tu 'byung*// de nas kha che'i yul gyi gtsug rga ba'i tshal du/

mkhan po sangs rgyas skyab dang*/ slob dpon ye shes 'od gnyis la dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs nas/ ming yang sangs rgyas ye shes bya bar btags so// des dge tshul yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma rdzogs pa yin pas/ rgya gar gyi dbus kyi gtsug lag khang su la kha dra zhes bya ba der/ slob dpon chos kyi ye shes dang*/ mkhan po chos kyi bla ma dang*/ slob dpon chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsum la/ dge slong gi bslab pa mnos te/ dge slong chos kyi rgyal mtshan du grags so// der mkhan slob de rnams la yang*/ thos bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad de/ sde snod 'dzin pa chen por gyur nas 'bri ka ma la shri lar tshogs pa yang bsdus nas/ bshad pa yang mdzad de/ gnas brtan bstan pa 'dzin pa zhes bya bar grags so// de nas na len tra'i nub sgo'i mkhan po a ba dhu ti ba zhes bya ba grong pa'i tshab mar spyan drangs nas/ mkhan por dbang bskur ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur nas/ phyi nang gnyis kyi rtsod pa byas pas lan gsum rgyal te/ tha snyad don tshol lcags kyu yis// rgol ngan mchil pa gzan la drangs// rig pa sgra tshad ral gri yis// rgol ngan sdong po rtsad nas bcad// lung ni rig pa'i sgron me yis// rgol ngan ma rig mun pa bsal// sdom gsum 'phags pa'i nor tshogs kyis// ma dag 'chal pa'i dri ma bkru// ma dag rkyen kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis// sgyu ma'i log 'tsho grong khyer bcoms// rgyal po paṇa chen spyan snga ru// na len tra nas bdar bdar nas// mu stegs ljon shing rtsa nas breg /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs// zhes gsungs pas/ der na len tra pa rnams kyis/ dpal ldan 'jigs med grags par mtshan btags so// de nas mkhan po'i bya ba chos 'chad pa/ bslabs pa 'bog pa dang*/ rab gnas byed pa dang*/ sems bskyed byed pa dang*/ dbang bskur byin rlabs mdzad pa'i tshe/ snga dro lta rtog mang ba mdzad/ nub mo chos mang po zhal thon mdzad/

bar bar du bskyed rdzogs bsgom/ de nas chos gcig 'chad pa'i dus na/ bud med rgan mo mi sdug pa'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa gcig byung nas/ res ngu/ res dgod cing 'dug pa la/ de don ci yin dris pas/ khyod kyis chos 'chad lugs dang tshigs la dga'/ don la ngu zer na/ 'o na khyod kyis gang shes bya'o// chos shes pa de tshigs shes nas 'chad dam/ don shes nas 'chad zer/ don shes byas pas mi dga' lo/ tshigs shes byas pas de ltar yin skad do// 'o na don sus shes byas pas/ nga'i ming pos shes zer/ de dang mjal bar khyod kyis khrid par zhu byas pas/ da lta phyin yang mi mthong*/ gsol ba thob dang 'phrad par 'dug gis zer nas mi snang bar gyur to// der nā ro pas/ bud med mi sdug pa'i mtshan gsum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa de mthong ba la brten nas/ phyi ltar 'khor ba'i nyes mig rgyu 'bras phra rag sum cu rtsa bdun rjes su dran/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du go /nang mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu rtsa drug gi rang lus mi rtag pa'i chos can du go /gsang ba ltar na/ rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis byang sems sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi gnad la brten nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs dgos par go /de'i gnad dang 'gro ldog rgyu 'bras su phye/ go lugs gsum du go ste/ 'khor ba gzhan skyon dbang ma rtogs// me dong bzod bral khri dong mun pa nag /dug gsum 'dam rdzab zab cing ngan song dba' rlabs drag /srin gyi kha chus 'thums zhing ba dag rgya'i sgrogs su tshud/ bdud kyi gnya' lag bcing mi 'dod dngos su chud// ri dwags smig rgyu bsnyags cing las kyi rgya mdud dam// sbrang ma rtsi la 'byar ltar tsha 'di ba mo 'joms// srin mo'i gling du 'khyams cing 'chi ba'i zhags pas bcing*// bdud kyi rlung rnams log cing snyigs ma'i spyod pa ngan// skye rgas grib mas gtugs ste 'chi bdag dbang gzhan bsgyur// 'chi bdag sha khyis zugs cing ri dwags rgyar chud 'dra// rngon pa brtse bral skyabs med lam 'phrang dogs// lam 'phrang drang bzhin gzungs 'dzin ne thang yangs// chos brgyad rta po rgyu cing mdung rtse rnga bro rdung*// gar mkhan mi rtag bsgyur cing chu shing snying po med// chu zla ngos bzung med de chu lbu 'khrul par snang*// chu gnyer na bun yal te log pa'i kun rdzob zhen// mi rtag dal 'byor lus de ru sgom ste/

bla ma ci mi btsal gsungs te/ rten dang cha rkyen dang dpe thams cad spongs dag byas te/ nga chos don ston pa'i yang dag pa'i bla ma tshol du 'gro gsungs te/ lam du zhugs nas gnas pa la/ byang sgo ba 'dza te ri pa dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal nas/ bstan rtsa dge 'dun sde yin bas// sde spangs chos min bzhugs su gsol// shar sgo ba mi thub zla ba na re/ bstan rtsa dge 'dun grogs yin pas// grogs spangs chos min bzhugs su gsol/ lho sgo ba nag po na re/ bstan rtsa chos ldan khrims yin pas// khrims spangs chos min bzhugs su gsol/ der na len tra pa na re/ mgrin pa gcig tu gsol btabs pas/ bdag cag mi shes gti mug pas// chos kyi sman pa mkhas dang bral// de bas dpal ldan 'jigs med grags// bdag cag don du bzhugs su gsol// ces gsol ba btabs pas nā ro pas/ skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa bral// bsags pa mdzad phyir bdag nyid la// mi 'chi thar lam ga la yod// ces gsungs pas/ sgra tshad bstan chos sna tshogs dang*// gnas lnga rig pa mkhas gyur nas// sde snod rgya mtsho 'i don shes kyang*// mtshan ldan bla ma med gyur na// skom pa'i tshad pa zhi mi nus// rgyud sde rgya mtsho lta bu yi// snying po byin brlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun// bla ma'i byin rlabs dngos grub kyis// rang rgyud tshim par ma byas na// rdzu 'phrul mngon shes yon tan rdzogs// du ma yod kyang don mi mthong*// de bas bdag ni ci nas kyang*// kye'i rdo rje las brtan nas// bla ma dam pa btsal bar bya// ces gsungs nas/ snam sbyar mkhar sil thogs nas/ shar phyogs su byon par bzhed pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' nas sgra grags te/ bde mchog 'khor lo la brten dang*// bla ma sangs rgyas lung bstan 'byung*// ces pa dang*/ yang de nas brtsams ste/ bde mchog 'khor lo cis mi bsgrubs/ gsungs nas me tog snam bu can gyi dur khrod du rtsa'i spyil po mdzad nas/

bsgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su/ dpal bde mchog yi ge bdun pa bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig gam gsum song ba dang*/ sa g.yo ba dang 'od dang dri zhim pa lta ba la sogs pa byung ste/ rmi lam na mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyi lung bstan pa dang*/ lo rgyus byung ba bzhin du dngos su yang byung ste/ shar phyogs ngos kyi tai lo pa/ gnyis med ye shes bde ba'i bdag /'gro don bde ba'i sprul pa can// bla ma sangs rgyas yod kyis tshol// ces gsungs pa'i sgra thos nas phyin pa dang*/ zla ba gcig tu sa phyogs mang por phyin yang bla ma ma rnyed pas/ ming tsam yang thos pa med nas/ kye bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas dag /btsal yang ma rnyed bdud kyis bslus// byas pa dang yang nam mkha' nas/ le lo'i bdud la ma bskur bar// btsal na bla ma sangs rgyas rnyed// ces grags nas yang tshol du byon pas/ dka' phran bcu'i spyad tshul ni/ 'phrang dog pa gcig la phyin tsam na/ mdze po sbra dang bcas pa gcig dang phrad pas/ des rkang lag rdum po des lam bkags nas 'dug pa la phar nur byas pas/ sna bkabs nas phar 'gongs pa la/ thams cad dbyer med gnyug ma'i don// rtogs med mtha' dang bral ba la// rtog pa dang bcas khyod kyis ni// bla ma rnyed par ga la 'gyur// ces gsungs nas se gol gcig gtogs pas/ mi snang bar gyur to// yang bye stong gcig na mar phyin tsam na/ khyi khog stod mi la zug pa/ khog slad rul ba bus g.yengs ba gcig dang phrad nas/ des lam 'phrang bcad nas 'dug pa la/ 'gongs nas song bas/ 'gro drug pha ma'i rang bzhin la// snying rje chen po ma skyes zhing*// theg chen lam du ma zhugs na// logs su btsal bas ga la rnyed gsungs/ der khyod ci lta bu gcig yin byas pas/ gang zhig gzhan la dman lta ba'i// khyod 'dzin bla ma ga la rnyed// ces mi snang bar gyur to// yang phyin tsam na/ mi gnyis kyi mi gcig gi mgo brdungs pas lam ka na 'dug pa la/

tai lo pa mthong ngam byas pas mthong ngas bstan kyis/ da yod mi 'di yi mgo rdung rog gyis zhes pa la/ khyod mi mgo brdungs ba'i rogs ngas mi nus snyams pa dang*/ snying rje chen po bstan pa la// bdag med stong pa mthong ba yis// ngar 'dzin mgo bo ma brdungs na// bla ma btsal gyis ga la rnyed// gsungs te se gol gcig byas pas/ na ro pa brgyal lo// de sangs pa dang bltas pas ci yang med nas/ yang 'gro zhing yod pa la/ mi gcig gis mi gcig gi khong pa nas rgyu ma 'dren zhing ral gri thogs nas gcod pa la/ te lo pa mthong ngam byas pa la/ nga'i rogs 'di gyis dang bstan zer ba la ma byas pas/ chos nyid skye med rang grol gyis// 'khor ba'i rgyun thag ma bcad na// bla ma rnyed par ga la 'gyur// zer nas/ mi snang bar gyur to// yang yul ljongs rgyu zhing mi 'phrad pa thams cad la/ dris pa rgyus med zer/ yang mi gcig gis chu ka gcig na/ mi'i sha mang po bkru ba dang phrad nas/ de la dris pas yang sngar bzhin zer/ de la rnam rtog skyes pas/ gdam ngag zab mo'i chu rgyun gyis// rang sems rtogs pa'i dri ma rnams// 'khor ba rang grol dri ma ma bkrus na// bla ma rnyed par ga la 'gyur// ces pas yang mi snang bar gyur to// yang lam gcig na phyin tsa na mi bag dang phrad pa la dris pas/ 'phrang 'di 'das pa na/ rgyal srid skyong ba gcig 'dug de la dris zer/ der phyin bas rgyal po la dris pas/ nga'i lha gcig ma long*/ nga'i 'bangs gyis dang de nas bstan zer/ de nas bsdad pas/ 'phyis lha gcig mos bor bas te gzhan la song*/ zhe sdang skyes nas mthu byed snyam pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' nas sgra grags pa/ 'dod yon la brten zhe sdang gis// ngan song gnas su skye ba las// bla ma rnyed par ga la 'gyur// sgyu ma'i skyes bus ma bslus sam// zhes zer ba dang*/ bden snyams te thon nas phyin/ yang chu ka gcig na mar phyin tsam na/

bud med 'ga' gcig la tai lo pa mthong ngam byas pas/ ri 'di yi rgyab na nags gseb na rngon pa gcig 'dug de la dris zer/ der ri nag 'thug po ri dwags mang po yod pa gcig na/ rngon pa nag po gos se po ra ri gyon pa/ mda' zhu thogs pa gcig dang phrad pa la/ rje te lo pa mthong byas pas/ des gzhu la oṃ tsugs byas na/ sgyu lus zhen pa med pa'i mda'// 'od gsal nyams kyi gzhu bkangs ste// ngar 'dzin lus kyi ri bo na// bag chags 'khor ba'i nags can du// gzungs 'dzin gyi ri dwags rgyu ba bsad// gsod la dga' ba'i rngon pa nga*/ sang ni gnas ngan bsod snyoms byed// ces gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to// ༈ //yang sang phyin pas gtsug lag khang gcig na/ mi 'dus pa kun la/ rje tai lo pa mthong ngam byas pas/ de cha med dmus lto pa tai lo pa bya ba gcig ni 'dug zer skad/ der nang du phyin pa dang*/ 'di yin zer na/ mdun na me gcig btang nas/ de la shig mang po bsrag cing 'dug pa la/ phyag dang bskor ba byas nas bdag rjes su bzung 'tshal gdams ngag zhus pas/ shig spar gang gtad de sreg gces pas/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// chos nyid lam gyi klong chen du// rnam rtog bag chags sdug bsngal 'di// bsad na 'dzad kyi sod la thong*// der spang bar bzungs te gsod ma nus pas/ rang skyes rang za'i rnam rtog shig /ma bsad bla ma ga la rnyed// nga ni nya pa rgya mtsho bsnyags// ces gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to// ༈ //yang yul phyogs gcig tu byon tsa na/ btsun pa rgan rgon gnyis/ de'i tsa na bu tsa gnyis 'dug /zhing rmo zhing 'dug pa la/ rdo dus la bab na 'dug pas/ dge slong gis tai lo pa mthong ngam byas pas/ dang por gdug tshod ran nams gda' bas rdo sol 'tshal zer nas/ nya mang po 'tshag mas bcus btsos nas btsun mas drangs pas/ nya tshod ma thungs pas/ phag du khyer te tshod ma thang du phos pas/ nya rnams 'phur te chu la song skad/

des rtog pas bcings pas bla ma dka'// nga ni pha ma gsod du 'gro zer nas/ gnas dang bcas pa gar song cha med do// ༈ //yang de'i sang mi rnyed dam bsam tsa na/ lam ka gcig na mi gcig pha ma bkyigs nas thag pas btags nas 'dug pa la/ tai lo pa mthong ngam byas pas/ nga'i pha ma gsod rogs gyis dang bstan zer/ ngas chos tshol du 'ongs pa la de rnyed dam/ khyed mtshams med byed snyam pa'i rogs ga la byed snyam pa dang*/ dug gsum pha ma ma bsad par// bla ma tshol bas ga la rnyed// ces gsungs/ nga ni ltad mo lta ru 'gro gsung nas mi snang bar gyur to// yang de'i sang phyin pas/ yul phyogs gcig na khrom chen po 'tshogs nas 'dug pa la/ der dmus long gi tshogs mang po gcig 'dug pa'i dbus na/ mi mig gcig pa gcig 'dug pa dang*/ de thams cad kyang gcig la gcig kha dog dbyibs 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'o zer ba la/ ya mtshan che bar byung ba dang*/ yang mig gcig po des rgyab ltag pa'i ngos phyogs su de dag kyang mthong bar 'dug pa dang*/ de dag la tai lo pa mthong ngam byas pas/ mig gcig po de na re/ spyir nged kyis tai lo pa ma mthong ste/ khyed snying nas tai lo pa tshol ba na// rgyud ldan bla ma'i rgyud la brten// lta ba rtogs pa'i ral gri phyar// spyod pa chos brgyad kyi rgya mdud khrol// sgom pa bde gsal rta po sgyug /'bras bu rang gsal nyi ma 'des// nyams myongs bde gsal me dpung sbor// rtogs pa yid bzhin nor nu ltos// mig gcig du ma ro gcig ste// dmus long lta ru med pas ltos// 'on pas nyan rgyu med par nyon// zha bos 'gro 'ong med par rgyug /dbug bral skye med g.yab mo rdobs// ces zer te/ rjes su bzung bar zhu/ snyam tsa na mi snang bar gyur to// ༈ //der thugs chad de/ bla ma'i sprul pa dang mjal yang mi phan par 'dug /da ni bdag bag chags rnam smin ma dag pas mi mjal ba yin snyam nas/

smre sngags 'don zhing*/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan rjes 'brang nas/ bstan rtsa dge 'dun sde bor zhing*// sdom ldan chos kyi grogs spangs ste// chos khrims ldan pa'i bka' bcags shing*// brtse bas gros 'debs ngag bcags nas// sdug bsngal dka' bas nyams blangs kyang*// bla ma rnyed par ma gyur bas// bdag gi lus 'dis gegs bya sam// 'di dor bla ma cis mi btsal// gsungs nas/ spu gri 'don tshad tsam na/ rje btsun chen po ral pa'i thor gtsugs can/ sku mdog smug nag pa cig byon nas/ bla ma tshol bas sangs rgyas dag /bsad pas bla ma cang rnyed dam// khyod 'dod sprang po nga yin nam// gsungs nas/ spyan bar snang du gzigs nas spyan chab byung*/ thal mo thugs kar sbyar te yus gsol ba/ nam mkha'i sprin bzhin ni nges med pa'i// rje btsun btsal bas ga la rnyed/ bla mas thugs rjes mi gzigs sam/ bdag ni 'di nas rjes su bzung du gsol ba btabs pas/ tai lo pa'i zhal nas/ snod ldan dri med gzi brjid khyod// mkha' 'gro ma yi gsang ba'i gnas// gsang sngags yid bzhin nor bu yi// gdams pa'i snod du da gyur to// ces gsungs pa ni/ rjes su bzung bas ste/ snod ldan rigs kyi che ba'o// ༈ //lung bstan rtog pas che ba ni/ dang po dpal rdo rje 'chang gis phyir mi ldog par bstan pa ni/ bde chen bde ba yi 'byung gnas kyis// byang chub lam bsten 'gro ba'i mgon// mgon gyur chos kyi spyan can gyis/ bcom ldan rtsa bshad phyir mi ldog /ces gsungs so// gnyis pa yi dam gyi lha dpal 'khor lo sdom pas/ pu la ha ri yi dgon par nam phyed na/ bla ma ljon shing lta bu yi// skye med sku yi rang bzhin la// 'khor gyi bya tshogs bsten mdzad pa// nā ro skye med sku dang ldan// bla ma chu rgyun lta bu yi// brjod med gsung gi bdud rtsi yis// nyon mongs dri ma 'khru mdzad pa// nā ro brjod med gsung dang ldan// bla ma nam mkha' lta bu yi// sgrib bral ye shes nyi ma yis// 'gro rnams mun pa sel mdzad pa'i// nā ro rtogs med thugs dang ldan// bla ma bsten byar lung bstan pa ni/

te lo pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/ rje btsun nam ka'i sprin bzhin nges med pa'i// de phyir nged rnams su la brten par bya// zhes zhus pas/ dran pa brjed med nā ro pas// bcu gnyis bar du nga brten byas// nga yi de nyid kho la yod// phyi rabs sems can don gnyer rnams// rtog par 'dod na kho la brten// ces brten byar lung bstan pa'o// ༈ //nyid kyi rang grol du bstan pa ni/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po yi lam// spros bral bsgribs med dri bral sems nyid kyi// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mthong bas na// ye shes rtogs pas su la'ang dri mi bya// gnyis med shugs 'byung rnal 'byor rang grol yin// ces gsungs pa'o// de ni phyi'i lung bstan tshol dus kyi bka'i dus so// ༈ //da ni nang sdug bsngal nyams len gyi dka' ba la brten nas/ gnyis pa dang po bsnyen lam dbang gi mthongs phye ba ni/ rje btsun tai lo pa de lus spang la phur pa btab pa bzhin bzhugs pa nas/ ngag lkugs pa ltar mi smra/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ngang las bzhugs pa las/ rje nā ro pas maṇ+ḍal phul/ phyag 'tshal/ skor ba byas nas/ gdams pa rjes su stan par zhu byas pas/ bum pa'i dbang gis brda bcu gcig nas/ gsang dbang gi bcu gcig /shes rab ye shes dbang gi brda nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du gsungs nas/ bstan pa de dag rim gyisabakrol ba/ bla ma nor bu rin chen la// dad gus dbang po 'gyur med byed// rang rgyud shel sgong ltar dag cing*// gdam ngag dran med chu rgyun thungs// chos brgyad tshe 'di yi rgya mdud khrol// chu snod du ma ro gcig yin// chos 'byung skye ba med pas ste// chos sku thig le nyag gcig yin// lkugs pa smra med brjod du med// shing thog bdag gzhan phun gsum tshogs// brda rnams bdag gis mdud bkrol nas// khyod ni brda shes skyes bu yin// mkha' 'gror ma yi gsang ba'i gnas// gsang sngags yid bzhin nor bu yi// smin byed sems kyi me long ltos// gsungs nas/
